notes.title: Update 9
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have made some additional fixes and improvements to the game, mostly stability and quality of life fixes. Here is the list of changes:

 Fixed an issue that happened when the movement controls were set to the arrow keys and this caused movement to abruptly halt for some strange reason. 
Now when this happens, you can just press any other key and everything will work as intended.
 We have added an additional startup option to the game: 
Vulkan mode, which should fix some weird compatibility issues with mainly AMD video cards.
 Fine-tuned the controller dead zone setting.
 We fixed a strange crash that could happen when interacting with the football.
 Some materials were too dark and are now fixed.
 Some localization fixes.


We hope you have fun and please leave a review if you like the game :)
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Update 7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are back with another update to the game, there have been a lot of small improvements over the past few months, which have all added up to this patch. So without further ado:

The Japanese translations has been meticolously reworked, which essentially means a complete overhaul of all the descriptions and story elements in the game.
We really hope that our Japanese players will enjoy this qualitative leap!

We have upgraded the engine version of the game to the latest Unreal Engine version, which should bring some additional performance improvements.

We also recently added the option to launch the game in DirectX 11 mode, which should help older systems run the game better.

We have made several small changes to the look and feel of the game:

 Completely remade glass materials, with several different variations for furniture, windows or lamps.
 We have changed the amount and behaviour of fog on the island, you should be able to see better, and the overall "greyness" you could feel in the garden areas should be greatly reduced.
 Some wooden surfaces have been re-coloured or improved.
 In low light settings, you should see less fog colour overlay.
 We have disabled the player's default depth of field effect. This means that the blurriness you experienced when looking at distant objects without zooming is gone.

We are steadily working towards the console releases of the game, first on Playstation and Xbox and hopefully on the Nintendo Switch 2 as well in the future. 

Of course, for our Steam users, we will include any upgrades and features that we develop for these systems.

That's all for now.

Please leave a review if you liked the game! :)

Have a wonderful day
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Update 6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have made some minor improvements to the game, taking your feedback into account.
Here is the list of changes:


 Loading in the game is now handled differently, resulting in much less RAM usage. This makes it possible to run the game with less RAM, and also reduces loading times.
 Every faucet in the mansion can now fill the pot with water, even the bathtubs!
 Checkpoint location shenanigans have also been fixed. You will no longer be reset to the shore checkpoint instead of the one closest to your location.
 Additional proofreading and localisation improvements have been made
 A small pot icon has been added under the painting puzzle in the dining room to indicate that the key to the kitchen can be found there.

Please leave a review if you like the game.

Have fun!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Update 5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce that we are back with another update, this time with several new features and improvements. So without furder ado, here is the list of changes:

 Gordian Rooms 2 is now fully Steam Deck compatible. 
We made several changes so that it gets the Verified badge.
 Steam Trading cards, Profile features and additional Steam Community items are here! 
With someone's favourite cabbage as the main focus. :gord2smile: :gord2heart: :gord2cry: :gord2cool: :gord2clown: :gord2angry: :gord2sus: :gord2wow:
We have made significant changes under the hood and as a result the game should run smoother, we have seen an increase of 15-25 FPS on average on the Isle of Lye.
 Thanks to the great efforts of WNM the game's Russian translation has been overhauled!
 We also went through the German, French and Hungarian translations so they should see small improvements too, your feedback was also included.
 We fine tuned some puzzle descriptions and corrected some typos in the English version as well.
 Controls have recieved some upgrades too, the gamepad thumbstick controls movement speed much better. 
Now slower, more intricate movement is possible.
 Additionaly there is a Dead zone setting for gamepad users, which changes the sensitivity of the thumbstick. You can use this to fine tune how fast you move and look around.
 From now on, the default graphics settings are set to low, to make sure that the game won't run into any problems.  Plus, we disabled head bobbing by default as well.
You can change these settings instantenously from the options menu.
 We added a RESET button for the Dining room slider puzzle. 
If you find this one difficult to solve, you can check this video for some clues:
https://youtu.be/1HEAa1vqTVI?feature=shared&t=188
You can decrease the playback speed on Youtube if you find the video too fast.


Please leave a review if you enjoy the game.

Have fun!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have made some additional changes to the game based on your feedback.

 Added a Highlight mode, you can activate it by pressing Left-Alt, by default. When you do so all items that you can pick up will be highlighted with a flashing white circle for a couple of seconds. 

Please note that if you have a lot of items that you didn't pick up in a certain area this effect may get overwhelming. The primary use of this feature is for locating items that you didn't find on your first or second inspection of an area.  
How frequently you make use of this feature is up to your preferences.

 We added the option to toggle always displaying the mouse cursor, so you wouldn't need to make an extra click once you are in the menus.
 We fixed an issue of not being able to pick up the horseshoe, once you have completed the Mask collection puzzle. Now youi can do so.
 Fixed a small issue of an infinite supply of crowbars.
 Fixed the issue of the football gate lights not remaining On after scoring a goal.
 Fixed some minor graphical issues


Please leave a review if you enjoy the game.

We read all your feedback on the forums.

We hope you have fun!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Demo version 1.3 and Puzzle Fest
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Since our last update we have been steadily working on the game, and we are happy to announce that the development of almost every back-end system has been completed. 

This means that now there is: 

a working tutorial, to introduce the various mechanisms of the game; the Objectives, Inventory and Journal panels for instance
a new hint system
a redesigned save system
localization support, so you can change between languages
full controller support, now in the menus as well and an alternative control scheme for just keyboards

We have also added a couple of community suggestions, for example the ability to toggle the inspection sound or a small target reticule to make it easier to navigate whilst playing.

As we have stated a couple of months earlier, the demo uses the latest lighting technology from Unreal Engine, Lumen. The entire lighting of the rooms has been remade with the advantages and shortcomings of this system in mind. Hopefully, now you should really feel like you are trapped in here during the evening.

notes.title: Progress Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A common question we hear is: "When will the game be released?” 
We originally predicted that we would be able to release the game in March. 
We've done our best to meet that date, but recently it became clear that we wouldn't be able to finish in time. 

That doesn't mean we haven't made a lot of progress! In Gordian Rooms 2, instead of being trapped in the titular rooms themselves, you will be able to explore a small island with lots of puzzles in and out of sight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/066f28dab20f143754274bbab50ad8cd23d18330.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/d1462156616bcdb458c015f5428389dac2c1ef13.jpg

Once you have made your way to the island, you will also find a lavish mansion with several rooms, each containing different puzzles:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/3e4f5dd0a60a64cba32ca2866c3b175c5b4c4634.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/529c6d148e481e02c6d2f62fa13de23b4f653148.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40221941/9d3b09772e6c6de6f6732d3df62f8059e6c17e9c.jpg

So hopefully it will be worth the wait! We are trying our best to finish the game as soon as possible, but with only 2 developers and only one published project behind us, we lack the experience to predict how long things will take.  

What's the release date then? 
Q2 2023. 

To be more precise would require us to make predictions again, which we have already shown we are not too good at. We will announce the exact date as soon as we know it, most likely a month prior. 

We spent over two years of constant development time on the game and don’t want anything to spoil the experience, so we kindly ask for your patience.

Thank you and have a nice day!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Demo version 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have just published the latest version of the demo, which brings about many changes.

First of all, we have switched the engine version from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5, mainly because the game takes place in one big island and thanks to some new lighting technologies (Lumen) it will be possible to have one single lighting setup for the complete scenario. 

This means that there will be real time lighting present wherever you go. 
So far we have been using a baked lighting method, which had several problematic aspects, like balancing indoor and outdoor lighting and just simply baking the whole island in one go, not mentioning that making changes required everything to be rebaked from the ground up. 
All of this has been resolved, obviously now we have different technicalities to juggle but we have managed to find a good balance so far.

This lighting system has been implemented in the demo as well, so don’t be surprised if everything looks a little bit different, some better some a little worse.

Apart from switching engine versions we have been hard at work on the Graphical User Interface of the game:

Now there is an Objective list, which details the steps you have to take for your goals, this will make much more sense in the final product, but you can see a glimpse of it in the demo as well.

An Inventory, where you can inspect the items that you have picked up and read any type of document you may have found.

A Journal detailing every comment of the character, making it easier to read them in case you missed something.

An Options menu, with adjustable display, audio and mouse settings. 

A Controls menu, where you can freely customize your keyboard or controller settings.

Last but not least, now there is also a title screen and main menu, with an intro sequence.

All that is left is to implement the character profile system, which entails saving and loading and the hint system. We also plan to add achievements and have come up with a new way to make localization more feasible. 

When all these are done we will implement a tutorial that will take place during the demo sequence. 

We plan to include the demo in the complete game and it will connect seamlessly to the main game. Obviously, you will be prompted to choose whether you would like to play this part of the game again or not.

Apart from these, we have been also working on the various puzzles and environments on the island, slowly but surely we are getting closer to completion. 
There is still a lot to do, and we would like to give you the best experience.

Thanks and have a nice day!
Adam and Laszlo
